classification: owner-requested post-result development experiment; not validation
semantic_mapping_rule: Only A∩B significator associations are eligible. No one-mapper-only association is scored.

hellenistic_western.mapped_house_rule: When a mapped house exists, its traditional ruler is evaluated with the same positive planet testimonies; a mapped significator planet occupying that mapped house adds one positive testimony.
hellenistic_western.mercury_sect_rule: No sect testimony for Mercury in the core V1.3 specifications.

house_placement_rule.note: Signs only; Lilly's published numerical house-point magnitudes are not used in the core no-project-weight arms.

lilly_traditional_western.mapped_house_rule: The sign ruler of the mapped Regiomontanus house cusp is evaluated with the same signed testimonies; a mapped significator planet occupying the mapped house adds +1.

parashari_jyotish.houses: whole sign from sidereal Lahiri Ascendant
parashari_jyotish.mapped_house_rule: The traditional ruler of the mapped sidereal whole-sign house is evaluated with the same signed testimonies. If a mapped significator planet exists and occupies the mapped house, add +1.

testimony_combination.per_tradition_domain_raw: Signed sum of all eligible +1/-1 source-grounded testimonies for all consensus mapped planets and mapped-house lords. No salience/directness coefficient and no prevalence/rarity weight.

aggregation_arms.rule: For each behavioral domain, sum tradition-domain signs then take sign once. The domain contributes at most -1/0/+1 globally.
For each behavioral domain, sum one -1/0/+1 sign from each tradition. Independent traditions can therefore stack, but verbosity within a tradition cannot.
Sum all signed source-grounded testimony hits across all traditions and domains. This intentionally tests the owner's hypothesis that multiple independent astrological testimonies may accumulate.

testimony_combination.fragility_rule: If only raw_independent_testimony_stack passes while domain_collapse_nonstack and cross_tradition_convergence_stack both fail, classify the owner fit as RAW_STACKING_FRAGILE rather than clean convergence.

behavioral_evidence_modes.rule: Every frozen neutral behavioral domain with relation=supported and behavioral_confidence>0 has weight 1.0. Not-established/unknown domains abstain.
Use the already-frozen behavioral confidence for each supported domain. This is sensitivity only, not the primary no-arbitrary-weight result.

specification_grid: 3 aggregation arms × 2 behavioral evidence modes = 6 predeclared core specifications. Report all six; do not select the best after reveal.

direct_regression.per_spec_pass: Target score strictly exceeds the 2013 comparator and is >= every same-date alternative score.
direct_regression.robust_pass: At least one of the two non-raw arms (domain_collapse_nonstack or cross_tradition_convergence_stack) passes under equal_supported. Raw-only success is insufficient.
direct_regression.century_rank_admission: Only after direct regression results are opened and robust_pass=true. No century ranking for a failed core specification family.

negative_control.rule: After direct regression, but before interpreting a favorable V1.3 result as robust, permute eligible consensus domain↔significator bundles within each tradition while preserving the number of mapped domains and each bundle's testimony count; compute how often a permuted mapping achieves at least the target-vs-2013 and same-date separation of the observed mapping.
negative_control.purpose: Estimate how easily the scoring architecture can manufacture owner recovery merely from mapping flexibility. This is a development overfit diagnostic, not a p-value for astrology.
